profile.description: WEC Energy Group is an American energy company based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. It provides electricity and natural gas to 4.4 million customers across four states.
profile.description_zh: WEC能源集团是一家总部位于威斯康星州密尔沃基的美国能源公司，为四个州的440万客户提供电力和天然气。
